svg.aria-label: Golden Sun English ROM coverage treemap
svg.text: Left: the whole cartridge — every byte already rebuilt from tracked sources, coloured by how it is expressed. Right: the audited executable denominator behind Full-C Byte Share.

Main-image tiles are address bands; overlay tiles are one resource each. Compressed overlay tiles are sized by ROM bytes and shaded by the decoded share each lane owns. Exact C: worktree · semantic C: origin/venus.
